# out of every row into this header.

#   2. check     — the type checker reports zero error-severity diagnostics;
#   3. compile   — the bytecode compiler accepts it AND its result is
# `expected` is the canonical core.Canon value carried over verbatim from
# the full matrix. Every row here is a trusted, three-way-agreed program;
# syntax_matrix_test.go re-verifies the invariant on each one.
